promises.label: Bring AI into Airbnb search
promises.commitment: Bring the AI-powered customer-service agent into Airbnb search over the coming years.
promises.outcomeSummary: Airbnb introduced natural-language and voice AI search, starting in the US, with AI-powered search-result descriptions.

missing.what_was_said: Management said it was testing a natural-language search box and generated search-result copy, and would launch AI search “imminently.” It distinguished this initial phase from later multi-turn conversation and an eventual integrated AI assistant or concierge.

Alongside the small live pilot, management emphasized rapid iteration rather than big launches and experiments to make search more conversational. Chesky also declined to put a timeline on AI search, saying AI was “highly unpredictable.”

Management said a test would begin that month for a very small percentage of traffic. Traditional search would remain the default, with AI search accessed through a toggle. Expansion depended on test results and conversion, and adoption would play out through that year and into the next.

promises.label: Support in over 50 languages
promises.commitment: Make AI customer support available in over 50 languages during 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: Airbnb reported its AI customer-support assistant available in more than 50 languages, meeting the promised rollout; its fall update confirmed continued availability.

promises.label: Accelerate 2026 revenue growth
promises.commitment: Accelerate full-year 2026 revenue growth to low-double digits, with an ambition to grow faster.
promises.outcomeSummary: Full-year 2026 guidance rose to at least mid teens and remains pending. The November 5, 2026 results update was unavailable for verification.

promises.label: Preserve 2026 EBITDA margin
promises.commitment: Keep the 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin stable year-over-year.
promises.outcomeSummary: Latest verified full-year 2026 margin guidance is at least 35.5%; achievement remains pending. Q3 shareholder letter and transcript were unavailable at the cutoff.

promises.label: Increase hotels' business share
promises.commitment: Expand hotel supply and exit 2026 with hotels representing a meaningfully larger percentage of the overall business.
promises.outcomeSummary: Hotels remained a single-digit percentage of nights booked, growing approximately three times faster than homes; the commitment to exit 2026 with greater share remained pending.
